description: PENSMITH_NETWORK_TESTS is the one test-lane live seam: only bin/lib/http-mock.ts networkMode() reads it, and only inside a test context (NODE_TEST_CONTEXT / PENSMITH_TEST=1), where it turns sources live for that test. No other bin/, mcp/ or hooks/ code may name it; everything else asks networkMode() / isOfflineMode(). A real user is live by default and needs no env.
